method: Current production Lua5.4 modules in isolated instances. No-op NanoVG, no GUI/GPU. Python time.process_time measures process CPU; perf_counter measures elapsed. Whole island timings: 3x72 frames. Ablations: 3 adjacent baseline/disabled/baseline pairs, 72 frames each; CPU delta uses mean adjacent baselines minus disabled. One-frame allocation with GC stopped then restarted. Local island upvalues discovered via debug.getupvalue; diagnostic replacements affect only this runtime. Component traces have extra instrumentation and measure elapsed, not CPU; do not add trace timings to production timings. Direct island calls are measured even offscreen to expose work that broad-phase normally skips. Synthetic radius/camera scenarios, not an exact reproduction of screenshot position.

timingQuality.reason: Large cross-sample variation, negative ablation deltas, instrumentation overhead, and shared outline upvalues. Use calls/allocations for this analysis.
